item.title: Pope Leo calls out 'delusion of omnipotence' fueling Iran war in vigil for peace at St. Peter's Basilica
item.summary: Pope Leo decries the "delusion of omnipotence" he says is driving the war in Iran, urging peace during a Saturday vigil at St. Peter's Basilica.

item.title: Trump greeted at UFC 327 in first sporting event appearance since start of Iran war
item.summary: President Trump attended UFC 327 in Miami Saturday night, making his first appearance at a sporting event since the start of the Iran war.

item.title: Swalwell faces expulsion effort following bombshell assault allegations
item.summary: Rep. Luna plans to bring a motion to expel Rep. Swalwell from Congress over alleged sexual misconduct claims, though Swalwell has denied the allegations.

item.title: Vance says US-Iran talks end without deal after 21 hours of negotiations
item.summary: Vice President JD Vance says U.S.-Iran talks ended without a deal after Iran refused American terms, calling the outcome bad news for Iran more than the United States.

item.title: Seven-foot statue unveiled honoring Magawa, award-winning rat who found more than 100 landmines in Cambodia
item.summary: Magawa, the famous landmine-sniffing rat who won a gold medal for bravery in Cambodia, has been honored with a massive stone statue in Siem Reap.

item.title: Christmas Vacation and Congress: 'We're all in misery' amid the ongoing DHS shutdown
item.summary: Fox News' Chad Pergram discusses Congress' prolonged DHS shutdown and the risky tactics associated with it as political divisions threaten deeper government funding crises.

item.title: Eric Swalwell accused of paying nanny with campaign funds while she lacked work authorization
item.summary: Two complaints allege Rep. Eric Swalwell violated immigration and employment laws to keep his nanny in the U.S. using campaign funds as payment.

item.title: Heather Graham says classmates dismissed her as 'nerdy' before Hollywood breakthrough proved them wrong
item.summary: Heather Graham says she was dismissed as nerdy in high school before her cheerleader role in "License to Drive" launched her career and independence.

item.title: Caitlin Clark's Fever make several key offseason signings in championship pursuit
item.summary: The Indiana Fever made key offseason signings to surround Caitlin Clark with talent as the team eyes a WNBA championship run in the 2026 season.

item.title: Artemis II crew reflects emotionally on lunar mission after safe return: 'Bonded forever'
item.summary: The four Artemis II crew members spoke for the first time on Saturday since returning to Earth on Friday after 10 historic days in space.
